summary: Heavy steel tower near McWilliams, Nipissing District, shown on a 1963 Department of Lands and Forests map; a Wikipedia article says it was to be moved to Field.

facts.agency: Ontario Department of Lands and Forests

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on location: firelookout.ca places the tower at McWilliams (the record's coordinates), while the West Nipissing Wikipedia article says it was to be dismantled and re-erected at Field. The Wikipedia sentence has no citation in the cached article, and the article gives no date, so it needs a better source before anyone relies on it. The register's Year Built field has no year, so no build date is given. Not found: staffing, fires, access. A Facebook group post titled 'Rip Nipissing tower' (dated 2024) may concern this tower; it sat behind a login and could not be read. Suggested checks: local Sturgeon Falls or Field news, or a Nipissing heritage listing, for whether the move happened.
